claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_reanimation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Prevents targeted remains from being animated as undead. Distinct from block_targeting (which prevents spells from targeting a creature) and grant_condition_immunity (which covers the 15 SRD conditions, not creature-type transitions). This is a deterministic protection applied to an object/corpse against undead-creation effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target is protected from decay and can't become Undead

claude_proposed_widenings.name: pause_deadline
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pauses countdown timers associated with resurrection window mechanics for the spell's duration. Unique effect type with no v4 equivalent — it modifies how other spells' time constraints are calculated rather than applying any direct effect to the target creature. Not expressible as modify_speed, grant_resistance, or any existing numeric-delta atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: days spent under the influence of this spell don't count against the time limit of spells such as Raise Dead
